name: Australian Antarctic Territory
note: The sectors 45°E–136°E and 142°E–160°E south of 60°S, carved from the Natural Earth Antarctica map unit.

name: Ross Dependency
note: The sector 160°E–150°W south of 60°S, carved from the Natural Earth Antarctica map unit.

name: British Antarctic Territory
note: The sector 20°W–80°W south of 60°S, carved from the Natural Earth Antarctica map unit by bounding box.

name: Vancouver Island
note: Carved from British Columbia by an approximate polygon; the Gulf and Discovery Islands are apportioned roughly.

name: Weihaiwei
note: Carved from Shandong by bounding box; the leased territory boundary is approximated.

name: Heligoland
note: Carved from Schleswig-Holstein by bounding box.

name: Minorca
note: Carved from the Spanish Balearic Islands by bounding box.

name: British Togoland
note: Volta Region plus a carved strip of the Northern Territories; the 1956 plebiscite boundary is approximated.

name: Northern Territories of the Gold Coast
Ionian Islands
aliases: United States of the Ionian Islands

name: Daman, Diu, Dadra and Nagar Haveli
Jammu and Kashmir (Indian-administered)
aliases: Princely State of Jammu and Kashmir

name: Telangana (Hyderabad State core)
note: Hyderabad State also covered Marathwada and Kalyana-Karnataka, which Natural Earth admin-1 cannot separate from Maharashtra and Karnataka. This unit is the Telangana core only.

name: Diego Garcia
note: Carved from the British Indian Ocean Territory map unit by bounding box.

name: Line and Phoenix Islands
note: Carved from the Kiribati map unit by longitude: everything east of the antimeridian.

name: British Northern Cameroons
note: Approximate: the strip of Borno, Adamawa and Taraba that voted to join Nigeria in 1961, carved from Northern Nigeria by polygon.

name: Kuria Muria Islands
note: Carved from Oman by bounding box.

name: South Sandwich Islands
note: Carved from the South Georgia and the Islands map unit by bounding box.

name: West Florida (Gulf coast)
note: Approximate: the Gulf strip of Alabama, Mississippi and Louisiana south of 32°28′N, carved by bounding box. The Florida panhandle part of British West Florida sits inside us-florida.

name: West Bank
aliases: Mandatory Palestine (east of the Green Line)

name: Kamaran
note: Carved from North Yemen (Al Hudaydah) by bounding box.

name: Perim
note: Carved from Aden Colony by bounding box.

name: Socotra
note: Carved from the Hadramawt governorate by bounding box.
